faq.question: What Amazon ad types do you manage?
faq.answer: We manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display. Strategy and budget allocation depend on your catalog, margins, and growth stage. DSP is available as a separate service when appropriate.

faq.question: How quickly can PPC improvements appear?
faq.answer: Bid, keyword, and placement adjustments often show impact within the first month. Larger structural rebuilds may take additional weeks as Amazon collects performance data.

faq.question: Do you require a minimum ad spend?
faq.answer: Minimum spend depends on catalog size and competition in your category. We discuss targets during the free audit and recommend a budget aligned with realistic growth goals.

faq.question: Will I retain access to my Seller Central account?
faq.answer: Yes. You retain full ownership. We work through authorized access with clear reporting on changes we make.

faq.question: How do you measure PPC success?
faq.answer: We track ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, conversion rate, and attributed sales against agreed targets. Reporting also connects ad performance to inventory and listing health.

faq.question: Can you manage PPC across multiple Amazon marketplaces?
faq.answer: Yes. We support advertising across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: Can you work alongside our internal team?
faq.answer: Yes. We collaborate with in-house operators on strategy, launches, and catalog updates while handling day-to-day campaign management.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a campaign review, strategy call with findings, then a management plan and onboarding.
